pages.text: Redstone carries a number from $(bold)0 to 15$(). Zero is off; fifteen is a torch, a button, a lever fresh-thrown.$(br2)Loose $(bold)dust$() loses one step per block travelled, so a signal dies fifteen blocks from its source unless something boosts it.
pages.title: 0 to 15

pages.text: $(bold)Repeaters$() reset a signal back to 15 and push it onward — the classic way to cross distance. $(italic)More Red's$() $(l:3_wiring/red_alloy_wire)Red Alloy Wire$() carries much further before fading, and climbs walls dust can't.$(br2)Many blocks $(italic)read$() the exact number — a $(l:6_reading/comparator)comparator$() off a chest tells you how full it is, 0 to 15.
pages.title: Boosting & Reading
